snippet.title: Into the Dead: Crimson Heights | Announcement Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Meta: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/into-the-dead-crimson-heights/8665198403580831

Into the Dead: Crimson Heights is a survival horror game that uses state-of-the-art Hyper Reality technology to map your real-life play space and transform it into an immersive, reactive, and expansive game world. 

Take on the role of the new superintendent of the Crimson Heights apartment building just before a disastrous zombie outbreak sweeps through Walton City. Integrate your real-world furniture and walls into the Heights as you sneak, explore and defend yourself in a desperate fight to survive.

_____

Into the Dead: Crimson Heights is the latest instalment in the highly successful Into the Dead franchise from publisher and developer PikPok. 

Find out more at: https://intothedead.com/

Follow Into the Dead:
https://discord.gg/Xd8RPnRZjx 
https://www.tiktok.com/@intothedeadofficial

https://www.twitter.com/intothedead   

Wishlist VR-only version on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4638740/Into_the_Dead_Crimson_Heights
